content.title: About
content.content: Mixed vegetable juice is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from a blend of fresh vegetables such as carrots, beetroot, tomatoes, cucumber and celery. The juice contains no added sugar, preservatives or artificial flavors, preserving the natural taste and nutrients of the vegetables.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Vegetable juices typically contain more B‑vitamins than most fruit juices.
The fiber content in vegetable juice helps support healthy digestion.
The vegetables used in the blend are often sourced locally, reducing the product’s carbon footprint.
The dark color of the juice comes from high levels of antioxidants like beta‑carotene and lycopene.
Vegetable juice is frequently recommended to athletes for electrolyte replenishment.

items.title: Rich in vitamins A and C
items.content: Vitamin A supports vision and immunity, while vitamin C boosts the body’s antioxidant defenses.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and supports normal heart function.

items.title: Contains folate
items.content: Folate is essential for DNA synthesis and is especially beneficial for pregnant women.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: Vegetable juice provides a feeling of fullness with relatively few calories, making it suitable for weight management.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Beta‑carotene, lycopene and other phytonutrients protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Allergy to individual vegetables
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to tomatoes, celery or carrots.

items.title: High sodium content if salt is added
items.content: Some commercial versions may contain added salt; choose a no‑salt option when possible.

items.title: Possible pesticide residues
items.content: If the vegetables are not organic, trace amounts of pesticides may be present in the juice.

items.title: Not suitable for infants under 1 year
items.content: Due to potential bacterial content and acidity, the juice is not recommended for babies.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mixed vegetable juice can be enjoyed chilled as a refreshing drink, incorporated into culinary recipes such as sauces, marinades or smoothies. For extra flavor, add a splash of lemon juice or ginger.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 2‑4 °C in its sealed container. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days. Do not freeze, as this may alter texture and taste.
